ترتجعن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِعْنَ (tartajiʕna) /tar.ta.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# تُرْتَجَعْنَ (turtajaʕna) /tur.ta.d͡ʒaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
